nodes.name: Webhook - Create Attribute Term
nodes.notes:
POST endpoint to create a new value/term for a specific attribute.
Accepts: attribute_id (required integer), name (required string), slug (optional), description (optional)

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Create Attribute Term
nodes.notes:
Creates a new term (value) for an attribute in WooCommerce.
Endpoint: POST /wp-json/wc/v3/products/attributes/{attribute_id}/terms
Handles 'term_exists' error if already created.
